limitations.quote: output reg wfull,\n    output reg rempty
limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the inverted RAM read enable but also changed when the Gray pointers and full/empty flags update and added reset gating to RAM accesses, whereas the reference preserves that behavior.

The scoreboard used the DUT’s own flags to decide which transfers to expect, so it checked data ordering and capacity without independently checking the cycle-by-cycle flag timing that the rewrite changed.
